description: iTesla Power System Library (iPSL), published by itesla, provides Modelica power-system component models for phasor time-domain simulation, developed by the iTesla project. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MPL-2.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The library supplies no power-flow or time-domain solver; component validation levels range from incomplete to validated. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: Compare model-openipsl, a separately catalogued Modelica component library; the existing record does not explicitly cover this iTesla repository.
name: iTesla Power System Library (iPSL)
notes: Identified reusable component library with its own repository and licence; not identical to OpenIPSL. Original discovery: A1/A1-0008. Geography and simulation-use tags are screening classifications.
